📖 The Eulogy narrates, honestly, always: "and then they knelt, and the story approved." The story leans in. (The Eulogy's attacks +15.) (2 verses remain. Contradict it — do the opposite — or give it a better ending.)
💥 Final Chapter!
Armor absorbs 24.
Eulogy's Final Chapter hits you for 42.
You go down.
OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Valentina West is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Valentina West is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Valentina kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Valentina's gone." Nathan looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Valentina." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Kanat blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Valentina West, 74 days. The mantle passes to Kanat Galymov.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Kanat Galymov, 28 — an emergency dispatcher. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Dowsing, War Cry, Scream Cheese.
You knew Valentina — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting them, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Nathan, Pavel, Sofia and 1 more speak for Kanat — "Valentina trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Kanat before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
